offering_description.value: Provides regulatory compliance software and services for public companies, investment funds and asset managers, including SEC filing, document management and proxy solicitation. Sells mainly to corporate issuers, law firms and fund managers through subscriptions and per-project fees.

primary_products.value: regulatory filing software; document management software; proxy and shareholder communication tools; fund reporting tools

primary_services.value: regulatory filing services; financial printing; proxy solicitation; fund administration; translation services

customer_segment.value: B2B: public companies, investment funds, asset managers, law firms, investment banks

end_markets.value: capital markets; asset management; legal services; corporate governance

revenue_model.value: subscription: software platforms for filing and document management; transaction or usage fees: per-filing and per-document charges; service fees: printing, proxy solicitation and fund services
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud filing and compliance platforms sold to issuers and funds; service provider: outsourced filing, printing, proxy and fund administration services for corporate clients

geography_served.value: global: clients in the US, Europe and Asia-Pacific, with offices in several countries

specialization.value: related lines: filing software, document services, proxy and fund services, translation, all sold to capital markets clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to corporate issuers, funds and law firms; online: online filing and document platforms used by clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: SEC and global securities filing rules shape its filing services, data privacy rules apply
